meta.description: Nintendo Switch emulator built from the Ryubing continuation source

doc.source: The current official Ryubing Forgejo repository exposes release 1.3.3 at this immutable commit archive. The normalized unpacked source hash matches the former repository pin byte-for-byte.
doc.build: The pinned source declares .NET SDK 9.0.100 with latestFeature roll-forward and builds src/Ryujinx/Ryujinx.csproj. Its retired updater NuGet feed is removed declaratively and the updater is compiled out.
